valores.label: Corridors available for a highway or rail link to Juneau
B.C. declines the Taku River Valley Highway

legenda: Lynn Canal and the Taku River Valley are the only two corridors (2018 study).
nota: O estudo de 2018 não diz que o campo de gelo cruza a fronteira (só cita 'Juneau icefields' e a IRA 'Skagway-Juneau Icefield'): esse item fica com a Nature, não conferida hoje.
narracao: Behind Juneau, an icefield straddles the border with British Columbia… That leaves two corridors… British Columbia said in 1993 and 2003 it wasn't interested in the Taku… the roads out cross into Canada and meet the Alaska Highway in the Yukon.
conferencia_status: CONFERE em parte (um item NÃO CONFERIDO NA REDE)

conferencia.item: o campo de gelo cruza a fronteira
conferencia.prova: nature.com redirecionou para login (idp.nature.com): parado. Conferido pelo dossiê em 23/09 (mec-20.1). Não é número. Vai ao navegador do app; o pesquisa-geo pode prová-lo pela geometria.
"Because of geographical conditions, only two corridors are available for a highway or rail connection between the continental highway system and Juneau: Lynn Canal and the Taku River Valley."

"In 1993, the B.C. Minister of Transportation was contacted… At that time, B.C. indicated it did not support pursuit of this alternative. In 2003… The October 2, 2003, response indicated that B.C. is not interested in the Taku River Valley Highway."

conferencia.item: Haines e Skagway chegam à Alaska Highway no Yukon
conferencia.prova: "The Haines Highway connects Haines with the Alaska Highway at Haines Junction, Yukon Territory. The Klondike Highway links Skagway to the Alaska Highway near Whitehorse, Yukon Territory."
